items.title: ‘Return the bitcoin’: Blockstream refuses ransom demand for remaining 600 BTC from Liquid exploit
items.summary: Liquid has resumed transactions following the exploit, though peg-outs remain disabled as recovery work continues.

items.title: Rising yields, oil prices leave bitcoin vulnerable ahead of U.S. inflation report
Bitcoin buyers wary of July sub-$58K floor amid onchain data ‘anomaly’
items.summary: Bitcoin HODL waves data revealed an unusually muted reaction to Bitcoin’s drop below $58,000, raising questions over its status as a bear-market floor.

items.title: Albuquerque Bans Bitcoin ATMs, Giving Operators 45 Days to Remove Them
items.summary: A councilor said 90% of crypto kiosk transactions in the city are tied to fraud, calling the machines a conduit for crime.
